subject.title: Install ClawHub packages for new Claw agents

question: Should the experimental Claws lifecycle ship shared plugin dependencies with warning-only operator removal, or require explicit force consent while Claw references remain?
rationale: Code review can verify reference accuracy and installer safety, but it cannot choose whether operator control should allow immediate breakage of dependent Claw agents; that decision controls the downstream status, remove, update, doctor, and recovery contracts.

options.title: Keep Advisory Removal
options.body: Permit warning-only removal after environment propagation, recovery semantics, upgrade proof, and exact-head live proof are complete.

options.title: Require Explicit Force
options.body: Block removal while complete or uncertain Claw references exist unless the operator explicitly accepts dependent-agent breakage.

options.title: Defer Shared Plugins
options.body: Limit the first Claws package release to safely owned package types until shared plugin ownership policy is approved.

recommendation.title: Keep Advisory Removal
recommendation.body: Permit warning-only removal after environment propagation, recovery semantics, upgrade proof, and exact-head live proof are complete.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the assigned active reviewer and have already driven the package ownership and removal-policy review for this stack slice.
